title: A Compendium of the Forged Body
summary: A compendium for those past the courses that adds a heavy drop-weight blow and a hide that turns hard strikes.

title: The Treatise on Breaking Weight
summary: A treatise on blows that fall with the full mass of the body to split guards and flatten hard targets.

title: The Canon of Tireless Recovery
summary: A canon of drills and breaths that restore the worn body of a fighter mid-fight and clear poison from his blood.

title: The Body Beyond the Skin
summary: Teaches how qi circulating through flesh and beyond it as a living field lets the body shrug off blows and strike farther.

title: The Twin-Armed Body Treatise
summary: Teaches striking and guarding with both arms as a pair so one blow opens the guard and the second lands.

title: Manual of the Azure Hide
summary: A manual of a hide kept bright and hard under qi that turns blows and carries the paired step of the Azure Sky.

title: The River-Bone Compendium
summary: A compendium on bones that carry force like a river and return the strike of a foe along the path it came.

title: The Wind-Sworn Body Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of stance and stride by which a wind-sworn student leans into the wind and drives through it.

title: The Oath of the Unsheltered Body
summary: A sworn manual of a body that takes no shelter and fills its frame with held qi to bear whatever comes.

title: Manual of the Bearing Held
summary: A manual of taking a bearing with the whole body and holding it against every push until the foe gives way.
